scripts.dev: npm run build -w @suraksha/contracts && concurrently --kill-others -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @suraksha/contracts" "npm run dev -w @suraksha/api" "npm run dev -w @suraksha/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @suraksha/contracts && npm run build -w @suraksha/api && npm run build -w @suraksha/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @suraksha/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
